findings.claim: AC2 parts without cases: arbitrate routed to arbiter, one arbiter per unfreeze case, barrier before Phase 2, restart re-reads --mode.
findings.closure: Named AMC cases pass, run red first: plan.md auto routes arbitrate/Plan critic, open to arbiter; orchestrate EXECUTE queue in auto launches one arbiter per case id; orchestrate requires barrier before Phase 2 in auto else blocked stop; a restart reads loop-record.py --mode.

findings.claim: No auto deny case for .claude/settings.local.json and .github/actions/*.
findings.closure: AM3 classifies .claude/settings.local.json and .github/actions/x/action.yml as denied, and AM28 denies a Write to each with the auto-mode reason.

findings.claim: Spec V8: ledgered paths' shell writes go without an ask in auto; plan keeps the ask.
findings.closure: AM35 asserts on an auto record that cp /tmp/a vite.config.ts passes with no ask and adds a tool shell guarded row, and still asks on a moi record.

findings.claim: Remaining asks in auto wait on a prompt instead of becoming the blocked stop.
findings.closure: An AM case: on an auto record, a .tdd-unfrozen write with no matching verdict row is denied with a reason naming the blocked stop; plus an AMC case: orchestrate in auto turns any hook deny/ask into the blocked stop.

findings.claim: Mode selection unreachable: --mode is moi until the Contract gate, spec line informational, so the gate is never opened.
findings.closure: Orchestrate names the pre-contract source opening the Contract gate (spec/handoff Validation: line) and says --mode governs only after the gate; an AMC case asserts it, including after a restart.

findings.claim: enforce-git-workflow.sh wired timeout 5 onFailure block; step 5 fetches up to 10 s, twice.
findings.closure: One fetch only, bounded under the wired timeout, and the wiring timeout raised to cover it; a contract case asserts the wired timeout of enforce-git-workflow.sh is at least the bound plus margin.

findings.claim: drop_record comments out only plan-row lines; verdict-backed .tdd-unfrozen lines survive as whole-file exemptions.
findings.closure: An AM case: auto record with unfreeze and refuse verdict rows and a .tdd-unfrozen line citing them; --clear and the PR-URL drop leave that line commented out.

findings.claim: Arbiter reads the hunk from git diff, which cannot exist before the unfreeze.
findings.closure: The plan names where the proposed hunk exists before the verdict (a patch file the arbiter applies to the current file in a scratch copy and hashes the resulting title) and AMC5 asserts arbiter.md reads it there.
